DcBesluitConsultatie.note: What you see: On a decision, the consultations of other governing bodies, the responses, any works council advice request and the public consultation.

DcBesluitGerelateerd.note: What you see: Typed links between decisions: replaces, withdraws, amends, implements.

DcBesluitVastleggen.title: decidiq: record decision
DcBesluitVastleggen.note: What you see: Record the outcome and date of a decision.
